tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search over the Splice agent docs (getting started, authentication, MCP servers, pricing). Returns the best-matching sections with their text. Use get_doc for a whole document.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: One agent doc as markdown: getting-started, authentication, mcp or pricing (pricing includes the live model table).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Enabled Splice models with their standard price in credits (100 credits = $1 on the Starter pack). unit "per_generation" = base credits each; "per_second" = credits per second of output (video); "usage" = billed on tokens. variants give per-resolution prices. Same data as https://splice.film.fun/pri

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Credit packs (fixed prices), sign-up credits, payment methods and what a credit is. For per-model prices use list_models.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Browse the public template library: curated model + prompt + settings recipes for images, video, music and motion. Returns summaries; get_template returns one with its ready-to-run payload.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: One public template by slug or id, with its generation payload (model, prompt, settings). Run it with the product server's generate tools, or open its url in Splice.
